why: URL, URLSearchParams, Headers, TextEncoder and TextDecoder are the platform's real classes (exec/fakes/web/url.mjs, headers.mjs, encoding.mjs); their state is in internal slots, so the generic rendering showed every one as {}. Rendered by the state the standard defines (a URL by its href, a parameter list by its serialisation, a Headers object by its entries), a returned URL built from another path (link), a renamed parameter (query) and a dropped header (accept) are each a WITNESS; under LEAN_FAKES=recording each is PASS-bounded, the gap closed. sorted (the same parameters appended in another order, then sorted) and bytes (the UTF-8 length through TextEncoder or Buffer) are refactors, PASS-bounded under both.
